buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Diglipur Division 1. GENERAL CONTRACT & DELIVERY DETAILS · Scope & Pricing: Goods only as itemized on GeM. Rates must be fully inclusive of base cost, standa rd packing, regulatory certifications, all applicable taxes, and transit/freight charges to the destination. · Delivery Location: Divisional Store, Diglipur (Assistant Storekeeper). Quarry products must be deliv ered directly to the designated project work site. · Timeline & Consignment: Supply must be completed within 15 days (MOST URGENT) from contract generation in a single lot. Part deliveries are strictly prohibited. · Contact for Queries: Shri Shiv Kumar Pandey (+91-9933279933). Technical/formal clarifications mu st be routed via the GeM portal. 2. ELIGIBILITY, EVALUATION & ANTI-COLLUSION · Bidder Assessment: Evaluation will strictly factor in the bidder's past performance track record wit h this Office/Division and rate reasonability as per GeM rules. · Preferences & Certificates: Bidders seeking regional or statutory benefits must upload valid local vendor proof (South/North & Middle Andaman) and MII/MSE certifications. · IP Address Anti-Collusion Clause: Bids featuring matching/common IP addresses with other Bidde rs or the Buyer will be automatically rejected at any stage of the tender process. 3. TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE & HARDWARE INTEGRITY · GNSS Architecture (Items 1 & 9): Base Station and Rover must feature a minimum of 1600 chann els. Bidders must attach factory datasheets confirming native satellite tracking across GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC, and SBAS. · Visual & Laser Integration: Rover receiver head must possess dual integrated cameras for AR Vision Stakeout and an integrated Class 3R green laser module. External bolt-on accessories are non-comp liant and warrant disqualification. · Interoperability & Interface: Hardware must feature a native web interface (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth) and s upport standard RTCM 2.x/3.x, RINEX, and NMEA streaming formats without external data converters. 4. SOFTWARE LICENSING & LIFETIME SERVICE · Perpetual Licenses (Items 20 & 21): Field Survey and Office Post-Processing software must be ful ly authorized, legal, and perpetual. Subscription, lease, or time-bound models are non-compliant. · OEM Declaration: Bidders must provide an OEM-signed undertaking guaranteeing free lifetime upgr ades/patches for core software, firmware, and coordinate/geoid databases. · Deployment (Item 22): Full installation, environment configuration, and license authentication on t he field controller and buyer office workstations must be completed prior to system acceptance.

5. COMMISSIONING, TRAINING & FIELD SLA · Turnkey Assembly (Items 23-26): Vendor must program local UHF radio frequencies (410–470 MH z), configure 4G NTRIP/CORS client profiles, and validate real-time base-rover correction handshakes. · Field Performance Check: System must physically demonstrate RTK precision (Horiz: 8mm+1ppm / Vert: 15mm+1ppm) and a minimum internal UHF radio line-of-sight range of 3–5 km prior to final sign-off . · Mandatory Training (Items 27-28): A 5-day continuous on-site training syllabus covering tripod se tup, IMU tilt sweeps, targetless laser workflows, AR camera alignment, and office post-processing network adjustments must be delivered. OEM-authorized certificates must be issued to all participants. · Warranty & SLA Support (Item 30): Comprehensive warranty covers all manufacturing defects, se nsor calibrations (4D Auto-IMU, cameras, laser), and battery assemblies. Remote support must be provide d within 24 hours. Critical hardware failures require a repaired unit or hot-swappable equivalent loaner wit hin 7 business days. 6. PENALTIES, COMPLIANCE & ACCEPTANCE · Quality & Enforcement: Sub-standard goods will be rejected. Late deliveries incur Liquidated Dama ges (LD). Defaulters face contract cancellation, blacklisting, and reporting to the GeM Incident Managemen t System. · Buyer Rights: The Divisional Forest Officer, Diglipur Division reserves the right to accept or reject an y bid at any stage without assigning any reason. · Token of Acceptance: Bidders must upload a signed, dated, and stamped copy of this ATC docume nt as unconditional acceptance of all clauses. .
